manifest.name: dsh-mlx-local
manifest.description: 在 Apple Silicon 上用 MLX 框架运行本地大模型:模型目录管理、服务启停、OpenAI 兼容 API,并优化 DSH 自定义提供方的本地思考强度选择。

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/stream.js && node --check lib/local.js && node --check lib/client.js
scripts.pack: npm run check && npm test && npm pack

bundle.text:
# dsh-mlx-local bundle patch
#
# 通过 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <路径|包名>` 安装时,CLI 会将本包加入
# profile 的 bundle 栈,并在启动时合并此 patch,挂载插件入口。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mlx-local
      name: 'dsh-mlx-local'

readme.text:
> 本插件是向DSH许愿得到的，本人不对其中的屎山代码负责。

> [English](README.en.md) · [中文](README.md)

在 Apple Silicon Mac 上通过 DSH 运行本地大模型。插件负责管理 Python 环境、启动和停止 `mlx_lm.server`,并把本地服务接入 DSH 已有的自定义 provider。

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 硬件 | Apple Silicon(M 系列)Mac |
| 系统 | macOS 13 或更高 |
| DSH | DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.1 或更高**(已实测至 0.2.2-alpha.2)及可用的 `dsh` 命令 |
| Python | 3.9–3.13,建议 3.10–3.12;未安装时插件会给出 `brew install python@3.12` 提示 |
| 网络 | 首次使用 HF 模型时需要联网下载权重 |
| 磁盘 | 每个 4-bit 模型约 2–6 GB |

当前版本 **0.5.3**。逐版变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md);这里只列升级前必须知道的。

> **0.5.3 是 DSH 0.2.2-alpha 的兼容性复核与新版本线支持,无破坏性变更。**

- 已实测在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5**(当前 npm `next`/`latest` 标签)与 **0.2.2-alpha.2**(npm `alpha` 标签)上完整可用:插件加载、启动链、设置页「MLX 模型」栏目、`/mlx/api`、设置写入、客户端模块图**全部正常**。
- **`peerDependencies` 补上 0.2.2-alpha 版本线**:三条 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 依赖加上 `^0.2.2-alpha.2`,`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 加上 `^4.0.6-alpha.1`,`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 加上 `^3.18.6-alpha.1`。DSH 启动时的 preflight 用 `includePrerelease` 语义,即使范围没写也不会拒绝加载;但 **npm/pnpm 安装**按严格 semver 判定,在 0.2.2-alpha.2 上会报 `ERESOLVE` / peer 告警——这正是本次修掉的「代码兼容但装不上」。
- **新增 `dsh.bundle.platforms: ["darwin"]`**(DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 起的 bundle 平台准入):在非 macOS 的 Host 上 DSH 会带着明确原因跳过本插件,而不是加载后才发现 MLX 不可用。旧版 DSH 忽略该字段,不受影响。
- `check:runtime` 增加**第 8 类检查**(`dsh.bundle.platforms` 合法性),第 7 类现在会区分「DSH 会禁用插件」与「仅安装期告警」两种严重程度。
- 新增离线回归测试 `test/peer-ranges.test.mjs`:把支持的 DSH 版本线(0.1.7 → 0.2.2-alpha.2)固化成矩阵,改 `peerDependencies` 却漏写版本线时 `npm test` 会直接失败。
- **开发依赖改为显式 `devDependencies`**(固定 0.2.1-rc.5 线),`npm install` 后可复现地跑测试;`package-lock.json` 同步刷新。
- 性能:环境保护探测结果缓存 10 秒(设置页轮询不再每 5 秒 spawn 一批 Python 探针);后台端口的 `lsof` 残留探测从每 2 秒节流到每 15 秒;设置页轮询增加 in-flight 保护。
- **兼容 0.2.2-alpha 的上下文窗口默认值变化**:`llm-pi-ai` 对未声明上下文的模型默认值从 262,144 涨到 1,000,000,会让本地模型的上下文压缩失效;插件现在为本地提供方模型补 `contextWindow`(目录值优先,缺省 131

- 已实测在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**(npm `next` 标签)上完整可用:具名导入、服务与方法、`llm/stream` 事件、设置页「MLX 模型」栏目、`/mlx/api`、Qwen3 思考强度补全与设置写入**全部正常**。
- **修掉一个「代码兼容但装不上」的问题**:`peerDependencies` 原来写的是 `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`,而按 semver 的预发布规则,该范围**匹配不了 `0.2.1-rc.2`**——`npm install` 会报 `ERESOLVE`(或装上后报 peer 未满足),尽管插件代码在 0.2.1 上完全正常。现已补上 `^0.2.1-rc.1`。
- `check:runtime` 增加**第 7 类检查**:peerDependencies 的版本范围是否被目标运行时满足,避免再出现「六项全绿却装不上」。该检查自带极简 semver 实现(`scripts/semver-lite.mjs`)与单元测试。
- **设置页在 `dsh web --host <局域网地址>` 下可用**(DSH 0.2.1 起支持把 GUI 绑到具体接口地址):`/mlx/api` 的 Host 校验从「必须是回环地址」放宽为「回环 **或** 恰好等于连接落入的本机接口地址」,DNS rebinding 防护不变。
- **本机判定改用 URL 解析**:新增 `lib/local.js`,让「思考强度补全」与「llm/stream 拦截器」共用同一判据,并修掉 `baseURL.includes("127.0.0.1")` 会把 `https://example.com/?next=127.0.0.1` 误判成本机服务的隐患;服务绑到局域网地址时也能按 origin 识别。
- `~/.dsh/mlx/logs/server.log` 改为跟随 `$DSH_HOME`(与启动探针 `plugin-boot.log` 一致),隔离 home / 测试 profile 不再把日志写进真实 home;venv 目录仍默认共享 `~/.dsh/mlx/venv`(可用 `venvDir` 覆盖)。
- `/mlx/api` 请求体加上 1MB 上限,超限返回 413。

> **0.5.0 是破坏性更新:只支持 DSH 0.1.7 及以后,且模型目录需要手工迁移一次。**

DSH 0.1.7 重写了设置架构,插件此前依赖的 `settings.installSection` 与 `settings.get` 被整体删除。旧版插件在 **0.1.7-rc.2 及 0.2.0-rc.1 上处于半失效状态**:设置页不显示「MLX 模型」栏目,启动链(接管外部服务、端口监控、Qwen3 思考强度补全)不再执行——而且**全程不报错**。本版按新架构重写设置接入,需要 DSH **0.1.7-rc.1 或更高**。

**升级时请做一次配置迁移。** DSH 取消了 `settings.yaml`,旧文件已被自动改名为 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported`;但本插件当时的 Config 没有 volatile 字段,DSH 导入时跳过了它,所以模型目录没进 profile。请在 **profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`**(如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`)里补上:

```yaml
- id: dsh-mlx-local
  name: dsh-mlx-local
  config:
    models:

然后重启 DSH。此后在设置页里的改动会正常保存,不用再手工编辑这个文件。

> **0.4.2 是针对 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 的兼容性复核,无破坏性变更。**

- 已实测在 **DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2**(npm `alpha` 标签)与 0.1.5-rc.2 上均可正常加载:具名导入、服务与方法、`llm/stream` 事件、客户端槽与 `__ModuleLoader__` 契约**全部未变**,无需迁移。
- 修掉一处**一直静默失效**的客户端注入:`dsh.client.inject` 原写的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` 从来不在客户端模块图内(它只是官方包的 devDependency,自身没有 `dsh.client` 声明),而浏览器端对图里没有的名字会直接跳过、不报错。已改为 `slots` 服务的真正提供者 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer`。此前「MLX 模型」栏目能正常显示是靠传递依赖与 cordis 服务注入兜住,故**升级后无可见行为变化**。
- 装 `0.1.6-alpha.x` 时 npm 会报 `ERESOLVE`——这是预发布 semver 规则的固有行为,**官方包同样如此**,用 `--legacy-peer-deps` 绕过即可;转正后的 `0.1.6` 不受影响。

- **移除了全部 `mlx_*` 工具。** 0.4.0 的 10 个工具(`mlx_status` / `mlx_list_models` / `mlx_add_model` / `mlx_remove_model` / `mlx_pull_model` / `mlx_setup` / `mlx_start` / `mlx_stop` / `mlx_switch_model` / `mlx_chat`)整体下线:本插件只负责把本地模型跑起来,服务与模型目录的管理请在设置页完成,不再由智能体代劳。**没有需要迁移的调用**——原先让智能体做的事,在 **设置 → MLX 模型** 里都能手动完成。
- **同时移除了系统提示词注入。** 此前插件会向每段对话注入一小段本地服务说明。现在插件对任何会话的固定请求成本都是 **0**。
- `inject` 收敛为 `["llm"]`,不再依赖 `tools` 服务,`peerDependencies` 去掉了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`;旧设置里残留的 `enableTools` 会被自动忽略。

> **从 0.3.x 及更早版本升级,还需要知道 0.4.0 的变更:**

1. **移除了「随 DSH 启动自动拉起服务」。** 服务现在一律由你显式启动——设置页的「启动」按钮。配置项 `autoStart` 同时删除;旧设置里若残留该字段会被自动忽略,不需要手动改 `settings.yaml`。
2. **DSH 要求提高到 0.1.5-rc.1。** 插件此前面向 `0.1.0-rc.x` 编写,在 0.1.5-rc.1 上**完全无法加载**(三个具名导入已被上游移除);同时客户端有服务改名与栏目排序的修复。**0.2.x 及更早版本请勿在 0.1.5 上使用。**

0.3.0–0.3.3 未单独发布,内容已并入 0.4.0。

标准插件的安装/更新/卸载都会改 profile,需要重启 DSH 后生效。从旧版本升级时先移除再安装:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mlx-local
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
```

然后重启 DSH。模型目录等设置现在保存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中,升级不会丢失。

readme.section: 方式一:使用 GitHub Release 发布包
readme.text:
直接安装:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
```

如果 DSH 不跟随下载跳转,先手动下载:

```bash
curl -L -O https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
```

安装后重启 DSH。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local.git
cd dsh-mlx-local
npm install
npm run pack

然后重启 DSH。

> 安装、更新、卸载标准插件会修改 profile,需要重启 DSH 后生效。

- 本地模型目录会保存在设置中;也可以在设置页中加载新的本地 MLX 模型。
- 服务**不随 DSH 启动自动拉起**:每次都由你在设置页显式启动,以免在意想不到的时候占用内存。
- HF 模型首次启动时会自动下载权重(需要联网);本地目录模型直接用「加载模型…」加入。
- 切换模型会先停止旧服务再启动新服务。
- 插件不会自动注册 `mlx-local` provider;接入统一使用 DSH 自定义 provider。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mlx-local
```

然后重启 DSH。插件设置和 `~/.dsh/mlx/` 下的 venv、日志会保留;如需彻底删除,可手动删除 `~/.dsh/mlx/` 和 HuggingFace 缓存。
见 [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。

> This plugin was granted as a wish from DSH. I am not responsible for the spaghetti code inside.

Run local large language models on Apple Silicon Macs through DSH. The plugin manages the Python environment, starts and stops `mlx_lm.server`, and connects the local service to DSH's built-in custom provider flow.

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardware | Apple Silicon (M-series) Mac |
| OS | macOS 13 or later |
| DSH | DeepSeek Harness **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer** (verified up to 0.2.2-alpha.2) and a working `dsh` command |
| Python | 3.9–3.13, recommended 3.10–3.12; the plugin suggests `brew install python@3.12` when missing |
| Network | Internet is needed the first time to download Hugging Face weights |
| Disk | About 2–6 GB per 4-bit model |

Current version: **0.5.3**. See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the full history; only the upgrade-relevant parts are repeated here.

> **0.5.3 is a DSH 0.2.2-alpha compatibility re-check and a new version-line support release — no breaking changes.**

- Verified end to end on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5** (current npm `next`/`latest`) and **0.2.2-alpha.2** (npm `alpha`): plugin loading, the boot chain, the **MLX 模型** Settings section, `/mlx/api`, settings writes, and the client module graph all work.
- **`peerDependencies` now include the 0.2.2-alpha line**: `^0.2.2-alpha.2` for the three `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages, `^4.0.6-alpha.1` for `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, and `^3.18.6-alpha.1` for `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. DSH's startup preflight uses `includePrerelease` semantics, so loading was never blocked; but **npm/pnpm installation** applies strict semver and reported `ERESOLVE` / peer warnings on 0.2.2-alpha.2 — exactly the "code-compatible but uninstallable" case fixed here.
- **New `dsh.bundle.platforms: ["darwin"]`** (bundle platform admission, new in DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2): on a non-macOS Host, DSH now skips the plugin with a clear reason instead of loading code that cannot work without MLX. Older DSH ignores the field.
- `check:runtime` gained an **8th check** (validity of `dsh.bundle.platforms`), and the 7th check now distinguishes "DSH will disable the plugin" from "install-time warning only".
- New offline regression test `test/peer-ra

- Verified end to end on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** (npm `next`): named imports, services and methods, the `llm/stream` event, the **MLX 模型** Settings section, `/mlx/api`, the Qwen3 reasoning-effort backfill, and settings writes all work.
- **Fixed a "code-compatible but uninstallable" problem**: `peerDependencies` said `^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`, and by semver's prerelease rule that range **cannot match `0.2.1-rc.2`** — `npm install` reports `ERESOLVE` (or an unmet peer) even though the plugin runs fine on 0.2.1. `^0.2.1-rc.1` is now included.
- `check:runtime` gained a **7th check**: whether the runtime satisfies the declared `peerDependencies` ranges, so "six checks green but the install fails" cannot recur. It ships with a tiny self-contained semver implementation (`scripts/semver-lite.mjs`) and unit tests.
- **The Settings section now works when the GUI is bound to a LAN address** (`dsh web --host <ip>`, supported since DSH 0.2.1): the `/mlx/api` Host fence is relaxed from "loopback only" to "loopback **or** exactly the local interface address the connection arrived on"; the DNS-rebinding defense is unchanged.
- **Local-service detection now parses URLs**: the new `lib/local.js` is
> **0.5.0 is a breaking release: it requires DSH 0.1.7 or newer, and the model catalogue needs a one-time manual migration.**

DSH 0.1.7 rewrote its settings architecture and removed the `settings.installSection` and `settings.get` APIs this plugin relied on. On **0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.1 the old plugin was half-broken**: the "MLX 模型" Settings section disappeared and the boot chain (adopting an already-running service, the port monitor, the Qwen3 reasoning-effort backfill) stopped running — **without reporting a single error**. This release re-implements settings against the new architecture and requires DSH **0.1.7-rc.1 or newer**.

**Do the config migration once when upgrading.** DSH dropped `settings.yaml` and renamed the old file to `~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported`, but this plugin's Config had no volatile fields at the time, so DSH skipped it during import and the model catalogue never reached the profile. Add this to your **profile's `cordis.patch.yml`** (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: dsh-mlx-local
  name: dsh-mlx-local
  config:
    models:

Then restart DSH. From that point on, edits made in the Settings page are saved normally and this file no longer needs hand-editing.

> **0.4.2 is a compatibility re-check against DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 — no breaking changes.**

- Verified to load correctly on both **DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2** (the npm `alpha` tag) and 0.1.5-rc.2: named imports, services and methods, the `llm/stream` event, client slots and the `__ModuleLoader__` contract are all **unchanged**, so there is nothing to migrate.
- Fixed a client injection that had been **silently inert all along**: `dsh.client.inject` listed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, which is never part of the client module graph (it is only a devDependency of official packages and carries no `dsh.client` declaration of its own), and the browser side skips unknown graph names without any error. It now lists `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer`, the actual provider of the `slots` service. The "MLX 模型" section kept working only because a transitive dependency plus cordis service injection covered for it, so **there is no visible behaviour change when upgrading**.
- Installing on `0.1.6-alpha.x` makes npm report `ERESOLVE` — an inherent consequence of pre-release semver rules, and **official packages behave the same way**. Use `--legacy-peer-deps`; the promoted `0.1.6` release is unaffected.

- **All `mlx_*` tools have been removed.** The ten tools from 0.4.0 (`mlx_status` / `mlx_list_models` / `mlx_add_model` / `mlx_remove_model` / `mlx_pull_model` / `mlx_setup` / `mlx_start` / `mlx_stop` / `mlx_switch_model` / `mlx_chat`) are gone: this plugin only runs the local model, and service and model-directory management belong to the Settings page rather than to the agent. **There is nothing to migrate** — everything the agent used to do is available under **Settings → MLX 模型**.
- **System-prompt injection has also been removed.** The plugin used to inject a short note about the local service into every conversation. It now adds **zero** fixed per-request cost to any session.
- `inject` is now `["llm"]` — the plugin no longer depends on the `tools` service, and `peerDependencies` drops `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`. A leftover `enableTools` value in older settings is ignored automatically.

1. **Auto-start with DSH has been removed.** The service is now always started explicitly by you: the **Start** button in Settings. The `autoStart` config field is gone too; a leftover value in an older settings file is ignored automatically, so you do not need to edit `settings.yaml` by hand.
2. **DSH requirement raised to 0.1.5-rc.1.** The plugin was written against the `0.1.0-rc.x` line and **failed to load at all** on 0.1.5-rc.1 (three named imports were removed upstream); the client half also needed a service rename and a section-order fix. **Do not use 0.2.x or earlier on 0.1.5.**
0.3.0–0.3.3 were never published separately; their changes are folded into 0.4.0.

Installing, updating, and removing a standard plugin all modify the profile, so a DSH restart is required. To upgrade from an older version, remove first and then install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mlx-local
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
```

Then restart DSH. Model directories and other settings now live in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and survive the upgrade.

Install directly:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
```

If DSH does not follow redirects, download it manually first:

```bash
curl -L -O https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local/releases/download/v0.5.3/dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-mlx-local-0.5.3.tgz
```

Restart DSH after installing.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JshGao/dsh-mlx-local.git
cd dsh-mlx-local
npm install
npm run pack

Then restart DSH.

> Installing, updating, or uninstalling a standard plugin modifies the profile and requires a DSH restart to take effect.

- Local model directories are saved in Settings; you can also load another local MLX model directory from the Settings page.
- The service is **never started automatically with DSH**: you start it explicitly from the Settings page each time, so it never claims memory behind your back.
- Hugging Face models are downloaded automatically on first start (network required); local models are added with **加载模型…**.
- Switching models stops the old service first, then starts the new one.
- The plugin does not register an `mlx-local` provider; use DSH's custom provider for access.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-mlx-local
```

Then restart DSH. Plugin settings and the venv/log files under `~/.dsh/mlx/` are kept; to remove them completely, delete `~/.dsh/mlx/` and the Hugging Face cache manually.
See [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.en.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.en.md).
